ValidationRule.description: Prevents MillTrack technicians from directly changing the Asset Name, Manufacturer, or Model on an existing Asset.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.MillTrack_Technician_Restricted_Editing, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Manufacturer__c), ISCHANGED(Model__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Technicians cannot change the Asset Name, Manufacturer, or Model. These machine-identification fields are maintained by authorized service management or administration.
